data.exact_reserve_text: During 2018 the Syndicate released GBP 35.2m of technical reserves in respect of prior periods (2017: GBP 39.4m), arising predominantly from the Treaty, Energy and Marine Divisions (2017: primarily from the Energy and Marine Divisions). These releases were due to favourable claims development on losses during 2018.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1084 reported a gross release of GBP 35.2 million in prior year reserves for 2018, primarily driven by favourable claims development on losses during 2018, predominantly in the Treaty, Energy, and Marine Divisions. The report also details significant catastrophe losses in 2018 from hurricanes Michael and Florence, typhoons Jebi and Trami, California wildfires (Woolsey and Camp), and the Ituango hydroelectric dam, with a combined net ultimate loss of GBP 57.3 million. Prior year events from 2017, including hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria, Mexico earthquakes, and California wildfires, had a combined net ultimate loss of GBP 96.4 million.
